name: HoverTome
summary:
HoverTome is a reading room that goes wherever you do. Your books hover in front of you on pages so sharp you forget you're wearing a headset — no blur, no shimmer, just words.

READ YOUR OWN BOOKS
Bring your EPUB, PDF, and comic (CBZ/CBR) files, plus MOBI — older formats convert automatically. Your library lives on your headset. No accounts, no subscriptions, nothing to sign up for.
